'''Kash''' is an [[Asha'man]] in the [[Black Tower]].

== Activities ==
He has only just turned up in the Black Tower but has become very strong in the [[One Power]] very quickly.

Regardless of [[Turning|turned]] to the [[Shadow]] or being a [[Darkfriend]], Kash showed up on the [[Field of Merrilor]] in the company of [[Alviarin Freidhen]], [[Rianna Andomeran]], [[Varil Nensen]] and [[Atal Mishraile]]. Through a clever trap designed by [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and [[Androl Genhald]], he and the rest were tricked into [[Stedding Sholoon]], where they were taken captive by the [[Ogier]].

He is presumably still alive and a captive of the Ogier.
